sloka: एष सेतुम् महाउत्साहः करोतु मयि वानरः ।तम् अहम् धारयिष्यामि तथा हि एष यथा पिता ॥६-२२-४५॥।।
transliteration: eṣa setum mahāutsāhaḥ karotu mayi vānaraḥ ।tam aham dhārayiṣyāmi tathā hi eṣa yathā pitā ॥6-22-45॥।।

translations.english: "This monkey is full of zeal. He will build a bridge over me, and I will bear it. In that way he is like his father."
